Hi Nina — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can prepare the pilot intake and procurement packet on our side: 

- Recap: pilot scope = real-time anomaly detection on 3 product lines, ~2M tokens/day estimated, 3 month pilot.
- Immediate asks: can you confirm the economic buyer for this engagement (name + email)? Also who will own PO signoff vs. the SOW signature?
- Finance: which legal entity should the invoice be addressed to and do you require a PO number up-front for vendor onboarding? If so, what is the typical lead time to generate a PO in your system?
- Security/compliance: I attached our vendor onboarding checklist and the security evidence template we use — please pass to your security or procurement owners and let us know any gaps (we can pre-fill fields where helpful).

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (summary checklist), security-evidence-template.docx (fields we typically fill)

Next steps I propose: once you confirm the economic buyer and finance contact, we’ll prepare a short mutual action plan and send a DocuSign SOW link for approval routing. Can we target an internal PO by end of next week (6/25)?

Thanks —

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers: 
- Economic buyer is Eleanor Ross (VP Product) — eleanor.ross@bluepeak.com. She’ll be the exec sponsor for budget sign-off.
- PO: we do require a PO up-front for vendor onboarding in our AP system. Typical turnaround is 5–7 business days after Procurement has a filled intake form.
